headline: Commission reviews board nominations, plans study of county boards

meeting.summary: Commission reviews board nominations, plans study of county boards.
meeting.recap: No members of the public signed up to testify.[[0:09:21]] The county's boards and commissions liaison and the Independent Nomination Board chair explained how board applicants are reviewed and recommended.[[0:10:27]] The nomination board chair said there are fewer applications for county boards than in the past.[[0:20:41]] He said a legal opinion bars filling seats that were vacant before the board formed in March until those terms end.[[0:33:28]] The chair deferred an update on recruiting for the commission's own open seat.[[1:33:15]] The commission began talking about the scope, or plan, for a study of Maui County boards and commissions.[[1:33:26]] The commission approved the September 18 and October 14 minutes with five votes.[[2:14:13]] A commissioner asked for a subpoena (a legal order) to get information from the Public Works director.[[2:40:10]] Staff and the deputy corporation counsel (county lawyer) said the commission must first authorize an investigation.[[2:40:49]] The commission lost quorum, the number of members needed to act, when a commissioner left.[[2:44:20]] The meeting adjourned at 1:21.[[2:48:01]]
decided: The commission approved the minutes of its September 18 and October 14 meetings with five members voting.
Without objection, the chair deferred the update on recruitment for the commission's own seat.
With no objections, the chair will acknowledge the testimony sent by Council Chair Lee.
meeting.next: A commissioner's questions about the nomination board will be sent in writing to the liaison and the nomination board chair. The technical writer will send members sample study scopes. The chair hopes to agree on a draft scope for the boards and commissions study at the next meeting. A possible letter asking county lawyers to clarify the vacancy on the commission remains an action item.
